description: One single full-body character for the SAME grounded modern supernatural investigation headquarters game as the style reference. Adult woman early20s, faded platinum blonde high ponytail and long bangs, dull gray eyes, serious analytical expression. Natural adult build comparable to Jyaldi, normal shoulders and limbs, no bulky muscles. Black tailored business trouser suit, black closed shoes. White shirt under a thin black ballistic vest; the BLACK SUIT JACKET is worn OVER the vest, its open lapels revealing the vest front. No external armor, oversized plates or pouches. Relaxed upright standing, empty hands visible at sides, feet flat. Front-facing SOUTH, body and face straight toward viewer; camera slightly above eye level, LOW TOP-DOWN. Realistic natural human anatomy about 7 heads tall; normal head and visible neck; crotch 45-48 percent of total height above soles. No chibi, giant head, shortened neck or exaggerated long legs. Full head and shoes visible, 6px minimum top/bottom margin, target crown-to-sole height 232-238px on128x256, excluding extra ponytail height; full-sized adult figure with normal head-to-body proportions; preserve the described individual shoulder width, torso fullness and limb thickness, not the reference male body. Match reference precise native pixel density, selective dark outlines, controlled pixel shading and subdued interior lighting. Keep THIS character own hair, iris and clothing colors. Crisp native1px clusters, no antialiasing, transparent background, no floor or shadow, no text, no weapons or held props, one character only.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY pixel rendering, outline, shading and lighting. Do not copy the reference male height, body shape, shoulder width, outfit or identity. Preserve this character own stature, build, age, hair, irises and original clothing colors and silhouette. FRONT view.
